content: E G B-flat D in D minor. The most important chord that is not the tonic in section 1
Augmented triad, diminished seventh, half-diminished seventh, French sixth, whole-tone chords. Schoenberg's name for chords that can go to many keys
where: Dehmel songs of 1899 and Verklärte Nacht

item: First note from outside the key
content: C-sharp in the bass, as part of an augmented triad (C-sharp F A). It is not part of a dominant chord
Ninth chord on A-flat (A-flat C E-flat G-flat B-flat) with the ninth, B-flat, in the bass. A Vienna society refused the work because of this chord
The bass moves by step or by fifth on the notes of the key. The chords above it are vagrant chords. This gives direction to chromatic harmony

item: Cadence plan with a weak dominant
content: Root motion 1 - 2 - 5, stop; 2 - 5, stop; 2 - 5 - 1. Step 2 has more weight than step 5. In bar 28 the dominant is only the bare note A
The bass of the dominant goes up one semitone (A to B-flat). The new bass note later becomes a key (B-flat minor)
The tonic comes directly from a chord that normally comes before the dominant (French sixth, German sixth, or the dominant of the dominant)
where: Mannesbangen; Jesus bettelt; Erhebung; Verklärte Nacht bars 319-320

item: German sixth as a link between keys
content: The chord A C-sharp E G is the dominant seventh of D. It is also the German sixth of D-flat. It goes directly to D-flat major
Soft cadences from the subdominant to the tonic release the tension
D, F-sharp, B-flat: the octave in three equal parts
Five of the six notes of a whole-tone scale in one chord, on a strong bass note
Harmony and a motto theme built from fourths
The chord C G-sharp B E A stays. The instruments that play it change
E-sharp F-sharp G G-sharp A, arpeggiated, on each slow beat. Five adjacent semitones

item: Cluster with the palm of the hand
content: E F F-sharp G G-sharp A B-flat C-flat. Eight adjacent semitones
where: The Night's Music (footnote 4 of the score)

content: The chord G A C D and the same chord one semitone higher sound together at the end
where: Mikrokosmos no. 107, Melody in the Mist

content: The middle or the contrast section is a tritone from the start. Examples: A and E-flat; C and F-sharp; G and C-sharp; F-sharp and C
where: Music for Strings I and II; The Night's Music; Sonata for Two Pianos I

content: Tonic axis: C E-flat F-sharp A. Subdominant axis: F A-flat B D. Dominant axis: G B-flat D-flat E. Notes of one axis can replace each other. Later authors do not all accept this theory
Different modes on the same tonic, together or one after the other. Phrygian and Lydian together give all 12 notes
Major triad with raised fourth and minor seventh: C E G B-flat F-sharp
Root, tritone, major seventh: F B E
Bassoons in minor sixths; oboes in minor thirds; clarinets in minor sevenths; flutes in fifths; muted trumpets in major seconds

item: Tristan chord that resolves to a pentatonic set
content: A chord related to the Tristan chord resolves to a pentatonic mode on C
x: four adjacent semitones. y: four adjacent whole tones. z: two tritones a semitone apart
where: String Quartet No. 4 and other works. Names from Perle and Treitler

content: A triad with its major third and its minor third together

item: Chord that functions as a tonic
content: E-flat D A E, held by the strings below fast solo passages. The chord comes from the solo melody
C, C-sharp, G, G-sharp come back through the full work
The open-string note A in unison, held, then pulled down to G-sharp
A chord sequence made from 12 pitches goes through the full movement. The chords dissolve into each other

item: Chaconne as the form of a long work
content: A repeated chord pattern below a lyric theme and fast solo studies
Cadences from chord 4 to chord 1 go through all keys below a long rising melody
"Amen" cadences (4 to 1) float around a hymn fragment
Many independent calls hold one note each at the same time. The result is a major chord
where: String Quartet III; Symphony No. 2 III (Nocturne)

content: Four chords in a slow pattern. Each chord grows from one high trumpet note that goes out through the brass
Semitone sighs divided into quarter-tones; two tunings that fight to be the tonic
where: Chiaroscuro; Pied Piper Fantasy (star music); Altered States

item: One interval for a full work
content: The fifth is in all three movements
